ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels and 60% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black core expanding into two lateral high-intensity white lobes. Left lobe (viewer orientation) contains horizontal low-intensity parallel lines. Right lobe contains diagonal and vertical low-intensity lines.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular linear boundary; left lobe trailing edge exhibits a large concave semicircular indentation; right lobe trailing edge distal tip exhibits high-amplitude jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory following a parabolic curve from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-intensity circular pixel clusters (white) located on the central dark region; dense, dark-on-white cluster on the far right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of low-intensity linear vectors (rake marks) cutting through high-intensity pigmentation on both lobes, exhibiting grid-like overlap on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semi-circular segment of missing tissue on the left trailing edge; substantial colony of biological organisms (barnacles) on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched pattern of linear scars forming a localized grid on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
